raw: {"open_points":[{"subject":"execute_function reflective attribute replacement","kind":"contradiction","text":"Reflective attribute access is rejected: never call getattr, hasattr,\n  setattr, delattr, or vars; every declared field and operation is\n  addressed directly by name, including in try/finally cleanup.","other_text":"A replacement is installed in one of two ways: an attribute of a module is replaced with setattr on that module; a method of a class or of a built-in type (datetime.datetime.now, say) is replaced by setting, on the class's module, the class's name to a subclass that defines the trapping method, since the __dict__ of a type is read-only and is never written. setattr appears only in the runner's source, which is a string the sandbox module writes into the exchange directory and the static gates do not read; the sandbox module's own code calls none of setattr, getattr, hasattr, delattr and vars.","question":"Must the absolute prohibition on calling setattr be narrowed to exclude the generated runner, or must the runner perform replacements without calling setattr?"}]}

set_aside.subject: execute_function reflective attribute replacement
set_aside.text:
Reflective attribute access is rejected: never call getattr, hasattr,
  setattr, delattr, or vars; every declared field and operation is
  addressed directly by name, including in try/finally cleanup.
set_aside.other_text: A replacement is installed in one of two ways: an attribute of a module is replaced with setattr on that module; a method of a class or of a built-in type (datetime.datetime.now, say) is replaced by setting, on the class's module, the class's name to a subclass that defines the trapping method, since the __dict__ of a type is read-only and is never written. setattr appears only in the runner's source, which is a string the sandbox module writes into the exchange directory and the static gates do not read; the sandbox module's own code calls none of setattr, getattr, hasattr, delattr and vars.
set_aside.question: Must the absolute prohibition on calling setattr be narrowed to exclude the generated runner, or must the runner perform replacements without calling setattr?
